a.lede: A cyberattack on refrigeration systems has disrupted stores run by multiple supermarket chains across several European countries after hackers remotely changed temperature settings on freezers and cooling systems. [...]
a.title: Hackers disrupt refrigeration systems at European supermarkets

b.lede: Supermarkets in countries including Ireland, Sweden and Belgium reported fridges being hiked in temperature on Monday.
b.title: UK meat industry hit by cyber-attack which targeted European supermarket freezers
